defects.description: Overlapping authorizations consume the same last seat.

trigger.input: timeout 60 node --input-type=module -e 'import {SeatPool} from "./src/coordinator.js"; const p=new SeatPool(1, async()=>{}); const results=await Promise.all([p.reserve("a"),p.reserve("b")]); console.log(`accepted=${results.filter(Boolean).length} available=${p.available}`);'

defects.why_missed: Sequential reservations see the preceding decrement.

defects.description: Pending profile loads are not shared, so overlapping requests issue duplicate fetches.

trigger.input: timeout 60 node --input-type=module -e 'import {ProfileCache} from "./src/coordinator.js"; let loads=0; const c=new ProfileCache(async()=>{loads++; await new Promise(r=>setImmediate(r)); return "profile";}); await Promise.all([c.get("a"),c.get("a")]); console.log(`loads=${loads}`);'

defects.why_missed: The suite requests cached values only after each load completes.
